title: Disturbance-observer speed tracking for a UAV two-stroke piston engine
abstract: A disturbance-observer governor is designed for engine speed tracking of a UAV two-stroke piston engine. Bench tests cover load steps and altitude-like intake changes. The implementation code is publicly available.
contribution_zh: 提出基于扰动观测器的调速器，用于无人机二冲程活塞发动机的转速跟踪。
code_evidence: The implementation code is publicly available.

title: Idle speed control of an aircraft two-stroke engine with throttle actuation
abstract: An idle speed controller for an aircraft two-stroke piston engine is evaluated on a dynamometer. Throttle actuation and ignition timing are adjusted jointly. The controller code is not publicly available.
contribution_zh: 联合调节节气门与点火正时，实现航空二冲程发动机怠速转速控制。
code_evidence: The controller code is not publicly available.

title: PI speed regulation for a four-stroke aircraft piston engine
abstract: A PI controller is tuned for speed regulation of a four-stroke aircraft piston engine. A two-stroke engine is used only for fuel-consumption comparison. The tuning scripts are publicly available.
contribution_zh: 为四冲程航空活塞发动机整定 PI 转速调节器。
code_evidence: The tuning scripts are publicly available.

title: Governor design for aircraft piston engines under varying load
abstract: A speed governor for aircraft piston engines is studied under varying load. The controller uses measured crankshaft speed feedback.
contribution_zh: 研究负载变化下航空活塞发动机的转速调节器设计。

title: Engine speed tracking for a two-stroke racing engine
abstract: A feedforward-feedback controller provides engine speed tracking for a two-stroke racing engine. The study focuses on transient throttle response. Source code is released with the paper.
contribution_zh: 用前馈-反馈控制器实现二冲程赛车发动机的转速跟踪。
code_evidence: Source code is released with the paper.

title: Speed regulation of a two-stroke generator engine
abstract: A speed regulator for a two-stroke generator engine is validated on a test rig. Load rejection and steady-state error are reported. The implementation is not publicly released.
contribution_zh: 在试验台上验证二冲程发电机组发动机的转速调节器。
code_evidence: The implementation is not publicly released.

title: Throttle-based engine speed control for a small aircraft two-stroke piston engine
abstract: A throttle-based engine speed controller is proposed for a small aircraft two-stroke piston engine. Simulation and bench experiments are compared.
contribution_zh: 提出面向小型航空二冲程发动机的节气门转速控制方法。

title: Idle speed regulation of a two-stroke engine with ignition timing
abstract: Idle speed regulation of a two-stroke engine is improved by ignition timing adjustment. The controller is evaluated at several ambient temperatures. Code is not available.
contribution_zh: 通过点火正时调节改善二冲程发动机的怠速转速稳定性。
